3. Which should matter more: SEVERITY or CONFIDENCE? 
Example: a ransomware alert the system is only 55% sure about, versus a port-scan alert the system is 99% sure about.
column5:
4. Which should matter more: SEVERITY or ASSET CRITICALITY?
Example: ransomware on a monitoring server, versus a port scan on the main PLC that runs the pumps.
column6:
5.  Which should matter more: SEVERITY or FREQUENCY? 
Example: one ransomware alert, versus 500 repeated fingerprinting alerts from the same source.
column7:
6.  Which should matter more: CONFIDENCE or ASSET CRITICALITY? 
Example: a 99%-sure alert on a minor device, versus a 60%-sure alert on the main PLC.
column8:
7. Which should matter more: CONFIDENCE or FREQUENCY?
Example: a 99%-sure alert seen once, versus a 60%-sure alert seen 200 times.
column9:
8. Which should matter more: ASSET CRITICALITY or FREQUENCY? 
Description: Example: one attack on the main PLC, versus repeated attacks on a minor device.
